The Company 

 InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. With over US$700 million in investments and 35+ portfolio companies including Palantir, Anthropic, SpaceX, Airbnb, SoFi, Spotify, DocuSign, and many more, we work with leading North American wealth management firms and family office clients to offer multi-position and single-purpose funds.

 InvestX is backed by leading financial institutions including Jefferies, Virtu Financial, and Canaccord Genuity and has been featured in CNBC, Forbes, Bloomberg, U.S. News, Business Insider, Reuters, The Globe and Mail, and other leading publications.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a driven, high-energy National Accounts, Associate to support the growth of InvestX's U.S. Broker Dealer distribution channel. This is a prospecting-heavy sales role for someone who enjoys opening doors, making cold calls, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified opportunities.

 Working closely with the National Accounts Lead, you will be responsible for building the top of the sales funnel across Broker Dealers and other wealth management firms throughout the U.S. You will research target firms, identify key contacts, execute outbound prospecting campaigns, secure meetings, and help move opportunities through the National Accounts pipeline and approval process.

 We're looking for a true hunter mentality: someone persistent, competitive, resourceful, comfortable hearing "no," and motivated by creating opportunities where relationships don't already exist.

 Location: United States (Remote) or Hybrid (3-days in office) New York

 What You'll Do 

 Prospect & Build Pipeline 

• Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into targeted Broker Dealers and wealth management firms across the U.S.

• Cold call, email, and leverage LinkedIn and other prospecting tools to identify and engage prospective National Accounts.

• Research target organizations and identify the right home office contacts, decision-makers, investment teams, due diligence professionals, and other key stakeholders.

• Secure qualified introductory meetings for the National Accounts Lead.

• Consistently build and maintain a strong pipeline of new opportunities.

• Follow up persistently and creatively to turn initial outreach into active conversations.

• Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts, opportunities, and next steps within Salesforce.

 Support National Accounts 

• Partner closely with the National Accounts Lead to prioritize target firms and execute the broader National Accounts strategy.

• Prepare research, meeting materials, prospect intelligence, and follow-up for prospective accounts.

• Support opportunities from initial outreach through due diligence and platform approval.

• Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and Sales throughout the approval and onboarding process.

• Track account progress, outstanding requirements, and next steps to keep opportunities moving.

• Support ongoing engagement with home office contacts, investment committees, due diligence teams, and other stakeholders.

 Develop Market Intelligence 

• Build a strong understanding of the Broker Dealer and wealth management landscape.

• Monitor competitor activity, platform developments, and trends in private markets and alternative investments.

• Gather market feedback on InvestX's products, positioning, and advisor demand.

• Identify new firms, contacts, and opportunities that should be added to the National Accounts pipeline.

 What We're Looking For 

• 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.

• Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting, cold calling, and generating qualified sales opportunities.

• Comfortable spending a significant portion of the day actively prospecting and engaging new contacts.

• A natural hunter who is energized by building relationships from scratch rather than solely managing established accounts.

• Persistent and resilient—you are comfortable with rejection and know consistent follow-up is part of successful sales.

• Strong communication skills and confidence engaging senior investment and wealth management professionals.

• Curious and resourceful, with the ability to research organizations and find the right path into an account.

• Highly organized with strong CRM and pipeline management discipline.

• Self-directed and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

• Collaborative and comfortable supporting a senior National Accounts leader while taking ownership of your prospecting activity and results.

 Nice to Have 

• Existing relationships within the Broker Dealer, RIA, or broader wealth management ecosystem.

• Experience with private equity, private credit, venture capital, hedge funds, or alternative investment products.

• Familiarity with Broker Dealer due diligence and platform approval processes.

• Experience using Salesforce and sales prospecting platforms.

• FINRA Series 7 and 63 or willingness to obtain relevant licensing.

 What Success Looks Like 

 Success in this role will be measured primarily by your ability to create qualified opportunities and expand the National Accounts pipeline, including:

• Consistent outbound prospecting activity and new account penetration.

• Qualified meetings generated with targeted firms.

• Growth of the National Accounts pipeline for new Broker Dealers

• Conversion of prospects into active due diligence and approval opportunities.

• Progression of firms through the approval process.

• Strong CRM discipline and consistent follow-through.

• Contribution to new platform approvals and, ultimately, asset growth.

 Salary & Benefits   

• 2026 base salary range is $130,000 - $160,000 USD plus incentive plan and equity.  

• Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, location, and qualifications for the role.    

• Comprehensive Health & Benefit plan. 

 If this opportunity sounds like it is a good match with your skills, background and career direction, please apply through our Careers Page ( https://www.investx.com/careers/ )
with your cover letter and resume.

CVX Venture Scout Programme 

 Do you have a passion for sourcing investments and making a difference for growth companies? Do you want to assist an extraordinary team of talented, motivated, driven individuals who all share a deep passion for entrepreneurship? If so, you may be our new Venture Scout. Please note, this is not a full time role, but we will provide remuneration based on success criteria. 

 Introduction 

 The CVX Venture Scout Programme is building a network of highly talented VC scouts, to assist us in sourcing attractive investment opportunities, in their specialist fields. You will learn and develop some of the most important skills required to be in VC, and meet with some of the most interesting and entrepreneurial founders in your market, and help shape the future.

 As part of your role as a CVX Venture Scout, the Investment Team will look to you to identify exciting startups, speak with them and conduct research on them, including their teams, markets, and competition. Based on your findings, you will write a 1-2 page proposal memo summarising your investment thesis, and may be asked to present it in-person or online to the CVX Investment Team.

 Expectations 

 We aim to use our Venture Scout Programme not only to discover exceptional investment opportunities but also to gain a deeper understanding of you and your vision. If you are interested in joining the CVX Investment Team, this is an excellent first step towards not only gaining an introduction to the VC ecosystem and learning essential VC skills, but also demonstrating how you think about investments, analyse them, and present your insights to us. As we grow our Investment Team, the Venture Scout Programme will be the first pool of resource we look to hire from.

 Compensation 

 We want to remunerate good work and give credit to your role in the investment process, where successful. We will therefore compensate you when a deal that you take forward to the investment team receives funding from our network of investors, with an opportunity for you to benefit from the upside too.

 Our Mission 

 CVX is one of Europe's fastest-growing venture investors, and we help ambitious and promising growth companies reach their full potential by investing capital, knowledge, time, skills, and network. We are driven by our conviction that the best investors are often those who, in addition to capital, provide founders with the right knowledge and experiences, skills, and networks in relation to the stage and industry in which the company operates. CVX always invests together with the best business angels for the respective founder, and today we have over 700 partners in our network who invest in companies and bring their skills into play where they can really add value.
